proposed_comments.title: Let the launcher UI consume the shutdown frame before disconnecting

confidence.rationale: The current shutdown path sends a graceful frame and immediately stops/disconnects the pipe; the validated replacement keeps the channel alive while the UI has a bounded chance to consume the shutdown frame and exit.

proposed_comments.title: Drain the registered wait callback before returning

confidence.rationale: RegisterWaitForSingleObject callbacks may still be running after Unregister(null); the validated replacement uses the documented completion-event form and waits for callback drain before the retained process identity is disposed.
